chunks: By the lying, the sinful forelock.

key_terms.نَاصِيَةٍ: Forelock (the leading part of the head), used metonymically for the person or their control.

ai.seo_question: What does the 'lying forelock' in Surah Al-Alaq refer to?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring specifically to the forelock of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) or the disbelievers, with many scholars emphasizing the 'lying' and 'sinful' attributes as indicative of the internal state of the disbelievers' will and intellect. The term 'khati'ah' (sinful/error-prone) highlights not just the act of lying but the inherent deviation from divine truth, serving as a divine oath to emphasize the gravity of their rejection. This characterization underscores the connection between the physical leading part of the body and the spiritual direction of the soul.
